field.label: Enabled
field.help: Query the ONT for the status page and the dashboard widget.

field.label: Device
field.help: Model of the ONT. Each model has its own driver.

field.label: Management address
field.help: IPv4 address of the ONT. The firewall needs an interface in this network, for example 192.168.100.2/24 on the WAN port without gateway.

field.label: Allow restart
field.help: Show a button on the status page that restarts the ONT. The internet connection is down while it restarts. Off by default, the plugin then only reads from the ONT.
